description: evals/margin/agent-definitions/claude-code-tether/hooks/run-prepare.js installs the bind-mounted wheel in-container by globbing tether_it-*.whl and reports the installed version via 'pip show tether-it'. The wheel-glob prefix is pyproject.toml [project].name normalized (- _ . to _), and the pip-show argument is the exact [project].name. Renaming the distribution requires updating both here, or the install matches no wheel and/or pip show finds nothing, blanking the tether-setup version marker and failing verify-smoke.py.
